categories.main_business_segments: Beijing FJR Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of infrared thermal imaging products and systems. Its main product categories include cores (modules), thermal imagers, and optoelectronic systems. The company also develops multi-spectral sensing technologies including solid-state low-light, short-wave, laser, and visible light products, serving both military and civilian markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in non-cooled infrared detectors, MEMS wafer design and manufacturing, packaging, detector drive control, thermal imaging image processing, multi-spectral fusion, and special optical system design. It has independent capabilities in CMOS readout circuit chip design, MEMS infrared sensor chip development, packaging, testing, and integration of infrared thermal imaging cores and systems. Production involves a combination of in-house manufacturing and outsourced wafer fabrication, with a focus on customized, order-based production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include military general units and civilian system integrators. Military applications cover general armaments, individual soldier equipment, ground, air, and naval platforms. Civilian markets include industrial temperature measurement, gas detection, petrochemical, power inspection, firefighting, and emergency response. The company maintains stable relationships with major customers, including China’s defense and electronics industry groups.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Beijing and subsidiaries in Henan, Shaanxi, and other provinces. It serves domestic military and civilian markets, with limited export sales. The company is focused on expanding its presence in the domestic market and reducing reliance on imports.
categories.supply_chain_position: FJR operates mainly in the midstream of the supply chain, focusing on the design and production of core components such as infrared detectors, modules, and integrated systems. It supplies these components to upstream military general units and downstream system integrators. The company is gradually expanding upstream capabilities by developing core detector chips in-house to reduce dependency on external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in infrared thermal imaging and multi-spectral sensing technologies, including non-cooled infrared detectors, laser sensing, and quantum encryption. It invests heavily in R&D, with 16.74% of revenue allocated to research in 2024. Strategic R&D projects include large-array detectors, advanced packaging, multi-spectral fusion systems, and AI-enhanced image processing. The company also focuses on talent development and collaboration with research institutes to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized infrared thermal imaging products and systems to military and civilian customers. The company follows an order-based production model with some inventory production for common components. It also earns income from technology licensing and government subsidies related to R&D and innovation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: FJR is positioned as a leading domestic provider of infrared thermal imaging products with advanced core technologies, especially in non-cooled infrared detectors. It competes with international companies mainly in the military sector but benefits from increasing domestic demand and import substitution trends. The company collaborates with state-owned military general units and aims to become a preferred supplier in both military and civilian markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 302 million, a 44.4% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.64 million. Total assets reached RMB 736 million, growing nearly 10% from the previous year. The company has shown a strong growth trajectory driven by expanding civilian market sales and improved product competitiveness due to in-house core component production.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FJR emphasizes its comprehensive in-house capabilities in core infrared detector design, packaging, and system integration, enabling customized solutions that meet stringent military and civilian requirements. Its products feature high image quality, low power consumption, compact size, and advanced multi-spectral fusion technology. The company’s continuous R&D investment and patent portfolio create high technical barriers, ensuring competitive differentiation and enhanced product performance.
